Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/lloyd-c-douglas/magnificent-obsession

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Lloyd C. Douglas, the author, died 1951.

First publication of the text used: 1929 (SE colophon: 'Magnificent Obsession was published in 1929 by Lloyd C. Douglas.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1929, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2024.
- Country of origin (the facts do not name the country of first publication; the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1951, so the text is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2022 at the latest.
